snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Escape From Cyborg Preview Video
snippet.description:
Time-Limited Event [Escape From Cyborg] will be open from May 1. During the event, Commanders can receive generous rewards including [Collapse Pieces], [Targeted Access Permissions], [Basic Info Cores] by participating in event Game Modes.

[Duration] 
2025/5/1 9:00 - 2025/5/21 18:59(GMT+0)
The event shop exchange will expire at 2025/5/28 18:59 (GMT+0)

[Unlock Conditions] 
Commander Level 20

Start playing on mobile and PC: https://gf2.haoplay.com/
